fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff:
MBA (Full-Time) [NCR-001]: Expected 99+ percentile; official admission uses weighted CAT score, not a published final percentile cutoff

MBA Executive (Evening) [NCR-002]: Not CAT-driven

MBA Executive (Health Care Administration) [NCR-195]: Not applicable: executive/HCA selection bulletin uses academics and individual assessments; no CAT cutoff.
fields.Eligibility:
MBA (Full-Time) [NCR-001]: Bachelor’s degree with ≥50% (45% OBC-NCL/EWS/PwD/CW; SC/ST passing marks); final-year candidates eligible

MBA Executive (Evening) [NCR-002]: Bachelor’s degree ≥45%; at least five years of executive/administrative experience under the brochure rules

MBA Executive (Health Care Administration) [NCR-195]: MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BUMS/BHMS ≥45%, or specified health/life-science master degree ≥55%; five years of qualifying health-sector executive/admin experience by 1 April 2026; employer NOC and Delhi NCR residence.
fields.Selection Process:
MBA (Full-Time) [NCR-001]: 2026–28: CAT weighted score 50%, Class X 10%, Class XII 10%, SOP discussion 10%, extempore 5%, PI 15%; women receive 5 additional marks. Interview shortlisting weights CAT sections VARC 40%, DILR 30%, QA 30%, with 5 additional marks for women.

MBA Executive (Evening) [NCR-002]: Academic profile, executive experience, discussion on executive experience, extempore and references/interview as notified

MBA Executive (Health Care Administration) [NCR-195]: 2026–28 bulletin scores: Class XII 10, graduation 25, executive-experience/SOP discussion 25, extempore 15, business-affairs discussion 10. Published table totals 85; no extra 15 inferred.
